evidence.quote: 2024 INSC 719 REPORTABLE IN THE SUPREME COURT OF INDIA CIVIL APPELLATE JURISDICTION CIVIL APPEAL NOS. 3593-3594 OF 2024 RAJESH MITRA @RAJESH KUMAR MITRA & ANR. …APPELLANTS VERSUS KARNANI PROPERTIES LTD. …RESPONDENT JUDGMENT SUDHANSHU DHULIA, J. 1. The appellants (the defendants in the suit), are here in challenge to the judgement dated 08.12.2022 whereby their Appeal was dismissed by the Division Bench of Calcutta High Court, upholding the judgment of the learned Single Judge (which was a judgment on admission), dated 29.06.2022.
